chunks.heading: 12.5 APPROXIMATION METHODS
chunks.content:
12.5 APPROXIMATION METHODS
Approximation methods in quantum mechanics are investigated in this section.
The WKB (Wentzel, Kramers, and Brillouin) approximation is first discussed.
Time-independent perturbation theory is then considered for estimating energies
and wavefunctions of systems that can be modeled as modified bound states with
known energies and wavefunctions. Methods of degenerate perturbation theory
are then developed for problems where the unperturbed systems have multiple
states with the same energy.
